name: Synth Pad
description: Slide your fingers to play: left and right change the note, up and down the brightness. Glowing, multi-touch and always in tune.
prompt: A multi-touch synth pad: horizontal position picks the note snapped to a scale (pentatonic, major, minor, blues, Japanese or free), vertical position opens the filter, with saw, square, triangle and sine waves, echo, glide, octave and glowing visuals.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Desliza los dedos para tocar: izquierda y derecha cambian la nota, arriba y abajo el brillo. Luminoso, multitáctil y siempre afinado.
